summary: This is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of common stock and warrants by Sharplink, Inc. The offering is a conventional capital raise, not a special situation. The company is selling 10,013,351 shares and accompanying warrants at a combined price of $7.49 per unit, with warrants exercisable at $8.15 for four years. The placement agent is A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, earning a 2% cash fee. There is no escrow, minimum proceeds, or structural complexity beyond a typical shelf takedown. No special-situation dynamics are present; the filing is an ordinary equity financing.
